messages:
Maria P: Quick heads-up — PR #20345 is ready for merge from my side. It wires in the new eviction fallback + routing fallback policy. Need runtime + SRE + security eyes before I merge. CI looks unstable on one e2e but I fixed the flake locally.

Kevin L: Can you paste a 1-line summary of perf impact? token latency p50/p95 etc. Also which model variants this touches?

Maria P: Perf delta minimal — p50 ~ +1ms, p95 +4ms on long-prefix workloads. Affects routing layer only; no sampler/kernel changes. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/perf/20345 (can view with SSO).

Devon R: Are we planning a canary? want to schedule during the 2h canary window today if possible.

Maria P: Yes — plan is 30m canary in us-west-2 then promote. No schema migrations.

Sana: Please include a short rollout checklist + alerting thresholds. We need an automatic rollback if error-rate > 0.5% or latency p95 increases >10%. Also add a playbook blurb.

Maria P: Added checklist in the PR description (see bottom). Quick paste: 
- deploy to canary (30m)
- monitor errors & p95 for 30m
- promote if stable
- manual rollback command: ```kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/orch-service --to-revision=2```

Alex G: Flagging security question: PR introduces a config flag `allow_fallback_without_audit` — is that default false? any additional KMS scopes?

Maria P: Default is false. No new KMS scopes — we reuse existing key ring. I added an audit-log entry in the patch.

Kevin L: LGTM from runtime perspective, just want one more runtime lead to ack the fallback logic.

Devon R: I'll take canary owner for the window. schedule 16:00 PDT. tagging infra-oncall & runtime-leads.

Maria P: tagging @runtime-leads @infra-oncall — can someone give final ack before 16:00? :pray:

CI Bot: CI: unit tests ✅, integration tests ✅, e2e flaky test retried — passed on retry. Build: 20345/7

Kevin L: :+1: from me, thanks Maria.

Sana: I'll watch the alerts during canary and trigger rollback if thresholds hit.

Maria P: Great — thanks everyone. Will merge after canary if no issues.

Devon R: noted. ping me when you start the canary and I'll run the smoke checklist.

Maria P: Will do. starting canary at 16:00 PDT — will post updates in this thread. :rocket:
